images.nearby_text: Table 3 shows that the gains persist across embedding models and target LLMs, especially on geometry and DetectiveQA; number theory shows smaller margins because baseline accuracies are already high, leaving less room for ordering to improve performance.

images.nearby_text: Across number theory and geometry, CDS consistently outperforms this high-curvature ordering in Table 4, supporting transition smoothness as a causal factor rather than a by-product of grouping similar examples.
